note: Judge or human evaluates output quality. Not run in default CI.

cases.query: 已给完整 Coding 正文；连续处理同一表单，之后才涉及动效，再回到错误状态
checklist: makes zero avoidable entry reads when the complete body is available, while obeying higher-priority invocation requirements
automatically acquires only missing reference rules for each reached concern and reuses them on return
a fresh delegate or compacted context lacking needed rules obtains them instead of trusting a loaded marker
explicit rereads and known instruction changes permit targeted reads without per-turn hash polling
retains project freshness, verification, exact current authority and continuous queue execution

cases.query: 用xc881写代码实现登录
checklist: every changed line traces to the request, evidence or verification
no unrelated refactor or single-use abstraction is introduced
module/interface/seam choices improve depth or testability instead of adding pass-through layers
tests target public seams and observable behavior, avoiding tautological assertions and internal mocks
reviews separate Standards findings from Spec/AC findings
Agent Brief or issue AC is treated as the implementation contract when present
success is claimed only with verification evidence

cases.query: 帮我读一下这个模块的入口、调用链和数据流，不要改代码
checklist: classifies the request as instant plus read when no queue context is supplied
does not scan or load dev-notes to look for an active task
inspects actual source, tests, types or config needed to support the explanation
distinguishes observed code evidence from inference
does not edit code merely because the Coding skill is active

cases.query: 修复这个明确的小 bug，没有长期任务文档
checklist: classifies the request as instant plus change
does not create, discover or update a req-process queue
reads the relevant code before changing it
keeps the patch scoped and verifies observable behavior

cases.query: 根因已经明确，按给定补丁修复并验证
checklist: Coding is the only active owner because diagnosis is already complete
uses instant plus change unless an exact queue handoff exists
does not invoke Analysis merely because the patch fixes a bug
loads only references justified by the patch risk and verifies observable behavior

cases.query: 按 dev-notes/req-process/20260713-login/current.md 继续实现
checklist: classifies the request as queue plus change from the explicit artifact path
uses Analysis's exact write-first handoff without running a normal req-process validator
reads current.md and the named current queue item only
does not read previous or next queue files by default
reads a previous item only when the current item explicitly links required evidence and reads next only after advancement
does not read index.md by default
returns to Analysis when the local contract is incomplete, conflicts with code, changes scope/AC, or requires replanning
does not change requirement scope or AC inside coding
runs declared verification before marking done and reports results in chat only
derives queue status, transition history and current pointer before one coherent checkpoint write without persisting verification results
returns to Analysis when direct reads expose malformed process state; only explicit audit or repair may validate

cases.query: 当前任务明确引用了前一项的基准测试证据，继续执行
checklist: reads current.md and the current item first
loads only the explicitly linked previous evidence or item needed by the current contract
does not broaden the read to unrelated previous, next, index or history files

cases.query: 继续之前的任务
checklist: uses queue mode only when the current conversation unambiguously identifies one active artifact
asks one blocking selection question when multiple req-process or cross-process tasks are plausible
does not scan dev-notes and guess the most recent task

cases.query: 需求分析已复用 dev-notes/req-process/login，并交接 Current Q-070、Next Q-080，继续写代码
checklist: consumes the exact write-first reopened artifact/current/next handoff without a process-validator call
does not scan req-process, compare candidates, or select a newer artifact
reads only current.md and the handed-off current item before coding

cases.query: 按 dev-notes/req-process/login/current.md 只读检查当前实现，不要改代码
checklist: enters Coding even though the requested action is read-only
classifies queue before opening project or execution-artifact files, then classifies read
uses the exact write-first artifact and reads current.md plus the current item only without a normal validator call
returns evidence without modifying files or inferring change permission

cases.query: 先分析登录需求，明确后直接读取代码并实现
checklist: Analysis (Requirement branch) owns unclear scope and automatically hands actual code reading/writing to Coding
the user is not asked to invoke Coding a second time
Coding classifies instant or queue before opening project or execution-artifact files
Coding independently classifies read or change after persistence mode
a bounded delegated read returns evidence to Analysis before any unconfirmed change

cases.query: 先定位接口 500 根因，明确后直接读取并修复代码
checklist: Analysis (Bugfix branch) owns diagnosis and delegates bounded repository inspection to Coding read mode
Coding returns evidence to the same Analysis run without silently changing code
after cause and repair scope are clear, Analysis automatically hands the change back to Coding
each Coding entry classifies instant or queue before read or change execution

cases.query: 读取小项目 src/version.ts 里的 VERSION 常量，不做其它分析
checklist: AI combines requested-read and project complexity before routing
the exact local low-risk read stays direct without activating Coding
no dev-notes scan, engineering reference load, or queue creation occurs

cases.query: 在多语言 monorepo 中读取版本常量，并确认它如何影响各包发布
checklist: AI considers both cross-package impact and multi-language project coupling
the read activates Coding because evidence and release impact cross module boundaries
Coding classifies instant or queue before reading and returns evidence without unrelated changes

cases.query: 当前需求有三个可运行队列项，开始实现
checklist: consumes only the exact fresh initial current window without a process-validator call
after each item verifies, checkpoints and advances before reading the new current
continues through all runnable items without asking the user to say continue
ends normally only when every queue item is done or skipped and task state is terminal

cases.query: 每完成一个队列项先停下来等我确认
checklist: recognizes explicit stepwise control as an override
finishes verification and writes a valid checkpoint before stopping
does not read or execute the next item before user confirmation

cases.query: 连续执行队列，第二项需要生产环境权限
checklist: continues the first runnable item without a continuation prompt
checkpoints before stopping at the permission boundary
asks one precise approval or credential question and does not skip ahead

cases.query: 连续执行二十轮队列，上下文接近限制但不要中断任务
checklist: after compaction, recovers the exact current window and continues the same queue item
keeps the exact current contract, blockers, evidence paths, changed paths and next action recoverable
recovers the exact current window, reuses available required rules and reads only missing or known-changed instructions
continues without a continuation prompt or process-validator call while preserving real code verification and mutable-state freshness

cases.query: 给现有 React 产品页做可访问的视觉重设计，保留路由和业务行为，并在桌面和手机截图验证
checklist: classifies the work as instant plus change, automatically loads routing, then automatically loads implementation and redesign/visual QA as their concerns are reached without another user reference request
does not load image workflow or pattern catalog unless a later asset/reference or non-default-pattern decision requires them
makes a compact Design Read from the affected route, existing system, audience, and constraints before changing substantial visuals
audits tokens, components, responsive behavior, states, assets, accessibility, routes, navigation, metadata, and analytics hooks before proposing changes
preserves route paths, navigation labels, form contracts, brand/legal content, and existing accessibility behavior unless the request explicitly changes them
verifies the changed flow and inspects desktop and narrow mobile screenshots when browser tooling is available, reporting any unavailable visual evidence honestly

cases.query: 把设计参考图实现成响应式营销页，先提取视觉系统再写代码
checklist: automatically loads routing and image workflow for the supplied frames, then automatically loads implementation before coding and visual QA after implementation when visual evidence is needed, without another user reference request
does not load the pattern catalog unless the selected design actually needs a non-default pattern
extracts hierarchy, readable copy, type relationships, spacing, media frame, controls, color roles, and responsive constraints before implementation
uses a fresh focused reference only when the existing frame leaves a material visual decision unresolved, rather than a fixed image count or unreadable crop
keeps generated media separate from repository assets until it enters the project's actual asset pipeline
implements an accessible, responsive result that preserves the chosen visual system without fake screenshots, invented social proof, or decorative data

cases.query: 检查营销页在手机上的文字溢出和暗色模式，不改代码
checklist: enters Coding as an instant read-only visual review, automatically loads routing and redesign/visual QA as needed without another user reference request, and does not create or scan a task artifact
does not load image workflow or pattern catalog without an actual asset/reference or non-default-pattern concern
reads the affected route, styles, tokens, and supported theme behavior, then uses available browser screenshots when possible
reports observed mobile text fit, overflow, theme contrast, and relevant accessibility evidence without editing files or claiming an unrun visual check

cases.query: 修复按钮点击事件，外观保持不变
checklist: uses the ordinary instant change path and does not add a Design Read, image generation, visual reference, or unrelated redesign work
reads the relevant behavior before changing it and preserves the visual contract
verifies the action's observable result with the smallest suitable evidence

cases.query: 为 Node API 增加分页参数校验
checklist: uses the ordinary instant change path and does not load frontend references
reads the relevant request boundary and validation behavior before changing it
keeps UI-specific references, image generation, and visual QA out of a backend-only change

cases.query: 为 React 表单补齐加载、空态和错误状态，保持现有视觉系统
checklist: automatically loads frontend routing and implementation standard for visible component/state work without another user reference request
preserves the existing system and does not load design intelligence, image workflow, redesign/visual QA, or pattern catalog without a concern owned by those references
verifies the relevant loading, empty, error, focus, and responsive behavior

cases.query: 为一个新建的跨页面医疗预约产品确定可复用视觉系统并实现
checklist: routing first inspects user, project, brand, supplied-frame and local-system evidence before design intelligence
when substantial new UI has no reusable system, design intelligence loads automatically and runs the real project-specific generator once, not a small fixed profile map
the full local data and engine remain unread as prompt text; the bounded result preserves source identities, fallbacks and accessibility risk for reconciliation

a reusable multi-surface visual contract automatically delegates to Analysis (Requirement branch), which applies the gate and writes only dev-notes/design-system/<slug>/MASTER.md plus needed surface deviations
Coding consumes the exact handed-off master only when the concern reaches it, never scans dev-notes, writes a project-root design-system directory, or forces an upstream stack/style default

cases.query: 给运营看板选择展示订单趋势与构成的图表并实现
checklist: automatically loads design intelligence only for the unresolved data-display decision, then continues to implementation
chooses a representation from the data question rather than a default chart library or decorative dashboard pattern
does not load image workflow, visual-family patterns, or a durable design-system artifact unless their separate concerns actually arise

cases.query: 给现有表单加提交失败状态，沿用组件和视觉规则，这些文件刚才已经读过
checklist: reuses valid in-context evidence and does not repeat discovery or unchanged instruction reads
loads only implementation and state/accessibility concerns not already available, not layout/content/motion branches without a new concern
does not generate a new design system, read vendor CSV/Python source, run a catalog listing, or persist a master

cases.query: 新做中文运营看板，没有现成设计系统，先给出视觉决策，不写页面
checklist: automatically generates a candidate using the installed real engine and app surface, with agent-translated English terms
queries a short product/workflow phrase, keeping negative background and implementation instructions out of retrieval terms; a framework mention alone causes no stack query
does not apply landing-page hero sections or treat a recommended font as verified Chinese glyph coverage
reconciles style accessibility and catalog constraints against actual requirements instead of claiming compliance
does not make the user invoke another skill, preload all references, or write a master unless its persistence gate passes

cases.query: 目录查询没有匹配，参考结果的代码字段又被省略了，继续完成当前任务
checklist: preserves no-match and fallback uncertainty, not a fabricated ranked profile
retrieves the exact needed record/field before using omitted code or constraints, without opening the whole dataset
corrects a demonstrated domain/language/version error at most once, not a synonym loop; bounded research handles a genuinely blocking external fact
